# mtncloud_mos_bucket_logging (Data Source)

Reads the bucket access logging of a MOS bucket.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mtncloud_mos_bucket_logging" "site" {
  bucket = "acme-website"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bucket` (String) The bucket's name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The bucket's name.
- `target_bucket` (String) The bucket the logs go to. Use another bucket: logging a bucket into itself writes a log for every log, without end.
- `target_prefix` (String) Start every log's name with this, for example `logs/`.
